name: Obuse Town
description: A compact cultural town in northern Nagano known for chestnut cuisine, preserved streets, and the Hokusai heritage that makes it a useful standalone travel hub.
highlights: Chestnut sweets and local food culture
Walkable historic streets and temple-town character
Hokusai-related cultural sites reserved for the secondary-depth review

ja.name: 小布施町
ja.description: 栗菓子、歴史ある街並み、葛飾北斎ゆかりの文化で知られる長野県北部の小さな町。周辺を歩いて巡る旅行ハブです。
highlights: 栗菓子と地域の食文化
歩いて巡れる歴史的な街並みと門前町の風情
北斎ゆかりの文化施設は二次深掘りで評価
